name: Valentina Herrera
bio:
Valentina's passion for motorsport ignited during her childhood visits to the Buenos Aires street circuit. Inspired by the aerodynamic innovations of legendary designers, she pursued a degree in aerospace engineering, specializing in computational fluid dynamics. Her early career involved stints at smaller racing teams, where she quickly gained a reputation for her data-driven approach and ability to optimize aerodynamic performance with limited resources.

As head of aero, Valentina emphasizes collaboration and continuous learning. She believes that the best aerodynamic solutions emerge from a combination of rigorous analysis and creative thinking. She is known for fostering a positive and open work environment, where team members are encouraged to experiment and challenge conventional wisdom. Her calm demeanor under pressure allows her to guide her team effectively, even during the most demanding race weekends. Valentina is constantly seeking new ways to push the boundaries of aerodynamic design, aiming to deliver a competitive edge that can make a difference on the track.

physical.hairStyle: long, wavy hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Valentina is a petite woman with sharp, intelligent eyes and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic sketches.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Prefers to conduct team meetings standing up, believing it promotes energy and engagement.
